notes.author: ted
notes.text: Coffee with Andy and Lauren. They moved from Denver for Andy's job and were members of a church there for ten years. They are looking for a place to serve, not just attend.

notes.author: alisha
notes.text: Owen's first Sunday in the kids wing. He was nervous at drop-off but found a friend by the end. Sent his parents a note.

notes.author: pete
notes.text: Lauren asked about the membership class. She said they tried a few churches after the move, and this one felt like home quickly.
